title: Neighbourhood Basics
summary: Ten easy minutes around the block. No gear, no hiking boots.

targets.clue: Find a tree. Put your hand on the bark, then take a photo of the trunk.
targets.label: a tree trunk

targets.clue: Look low. Find a flower, wild or planted, and photograph it.
targets.label: a flower

targets.clue: Stand still for twenty seconds and listen. Photograph any bird you can see.
targets.label: a bird

targets.clue: Look straight up. Photograph the clouds, or the empty sky if there are none.
targets.label: clouds in the sky

targets.clue: Say hello to a dog, with its owner's permission. Photograph the dog.
targets.label: a dog
